purpose: Compile discovery and the smallest material owner answers into one exact, reviewable, resumable Bootstrap creation plan.
question_rule: Ask only the earliest unresolved field whose answer cannot be discovered, safely defaulted, derived, or deferred without changing the first route, authority, proof, rollback, or owner boundary. The canonical output-gap matrix is the question planner's authority.

approval.rule: Bootstrap displays the complete plan and SHA-256 before approval. The approval receipt binds the exact plan digest, discovery digest, actor, time, and execution boundary. A generic PROCEED answer is insufficient.
approval.toctou: Re-read discovery, source identities, destination containment, and plan digest immediately before each external side effect. A mismatch returns to planning without mutation.

plan_identity.rule: The exact plan always binds the canonical project root, the discovery mode and digest used to compile it, and the imported source content and filesystem observation when a legacy corpus is selected. Before staging, Bootstrap re-observes the same root and refuses changed discovery, source bytes, or imported source identity.

execution.rule: Stage writes under a contained temporary directory, seal the complete staged file inventory and digest, verify readback and all receipts, then promote each exact staged root without overwriting a different digest. Resume from the last sealed phase using the same plan and staged inventory; already promoted exact roots are accepted, different bytes are rejected, and repeat execution is idempotent.
execution.legacy_gate: When an existing authority corpus is imported or refactored, legacy.zip, legacy.manifest.json, legacy.index.jsonl, and legacy.receipt.json are created and verified before replacement corpus writes.

security_baseline.rule: The security standard identity, version, requirement IDs, and their digest are explicit and content-addressed.

delivery_policy.binding_rule: The delivery policy, explicit delivery target, read-only probe plan, exact creation plan, discovery digest, and final Bootstrap plan digest must bind one another.

project_life_contract.rule: Maturity, assurance, audience, data posture, lifetime, maintenance, portability, commercialization, and retirement are one compact owner-intent contract. A private-prototype default is allowed only when no material route, audience, data, or lifetime signal exists.

boundary_contract.rule: Constitutional, owner-sovereign, derived-operating, and temporary-probe boundaries are explicit. More restrictive boundaries win; project extensions cannot weaken the portable kernel or owner authority.

delivery_target.rule: A target family, maturity mode, audience, data posture, authentication route, limitations, and optional project-bound adapter are content-addressed. Managed-site prototype and limited-product routes are available without implying production capability.

bootstrap_coverage.rule: Every required setup obligation has one deterministic row with applicability, provenance, status, safe default, probe requirement, owner boundary, unavailable behavior, reopen triggers, dependencies, and exact compiled field paths. Material gaps block exact-plan compilation.

exact_creation_plan_binding.rule: The exact creation plan must carry the exact coverage, life-contract, delivery-target, and boundary-contract digests. A plan cannot be approved when any required contract is pending or differs.

delivery_probe_gate.rule: Execution runs the five-probe read-only plan before setup writes continue. The result is bound to the approved plan digest, delivery-policy digest, discovery digest, and canonical project root; owner-boundary probes remain NOT_RUN_OWNER_BOUNDARY.

extension_boundary: Project-specific context can fill typed fields and add stricter clauses, but cannot remove required output groups, weaken lifecycle, change acceptance roots, or replace the portable kernel.
